title: Remove the redundant post-ACK StateInner reacquisition from test-run registration
outcome: A durably acknowledged test registration returns its exact validated acknowledgement from the same StateInner publication acquisition, without waiting again behind unrelated rescans; pending and disconnected-client outcomes stay truthful.
acceptance: An incident note preserves the existing registration and overlapping rescan phase points, client abort and writer-progress evidence for 19594754, b4990847 and eacff8a8, explicitly separating missing observations, whole-tick age, StateInner waits/holds, durable acknowledgement and response readiness; it makes no unsupported claim that 4–8 seconds was SQLite commit time. Source inspection distinguishes resolve_project’s StateInner-only session/project lookup from the later filesystem/Git phases; the earlier 3.12-second phase is not attributed to a later non-overlapping rescan, and unavailable per-lock wait/hold observations remain unknown.

After the exact registration fence acknowledges and request.json identity is rechecked, one StateInner publication acquisition validates the original registration identity, marks that exact run registered and constructs its acknowledgement. A second unrelated StateInner acquisition or test-run rescan is not required before returning that acknowledgement. Existing changed-request, changed-owner, durability, pending and supersession checks are preserved; no deadline, writer policy or execution authority is widened.

Deterministic tests using the existing real background writer and barrier/clock seams cover the post-acknowledgement lock-contention schedule, exact replay and changed-identity refusal. A disconnected or timed-out client may leave a durable registration; this is represented honestly as a registered but unexecuted failed/indeterminate run, never as test success, execution credit or proven non-application. No test stage starts without the launcher's original acknowledged identity.

Credited focused verification and the final maintained gate pass on the exact input with an independent review pair free of outstanding Medium or higher. The remaining writer-subphase attribution and post-restart/load observation stay open on the parent; this slice alone does not claim to fix every writer stall.
